verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that Amplitude documents an official MCP server at amplitude.com/mcp-server, so the product itself offers an official MCP endpoint that agents can connect to. The evidence is only a single probe line, though, with no detail on setup, authentication, or which Experiment operations (flags, experiments, deployments) the server exposes. Missing for 10: documentation of the MCP server's Experiment-specific tools, connection/auth setup details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://amplitude.com/mcp-server
